{"class": "architectural",
 "chokepoint": [
  {"operator": "fd_read of SRC's 512 MiB into linear memory",
   "component": "WASI fd_read",
   "frozen": true,
   "why_every_version_executes_it": "Preview1 has no clone, splice or copy call, so every byte of SRC must enter linear memory through fd_read before it can be written.",
   "least_work": {"amount": 536870912, "unit": "bytes", "per_unit_cost_us": 0.000125, "total_ms": 67.11,
                  "calling_context": "Large buffers (1 MiB or more), warm page cache, at the native read() rate of 8 GB/s with zero WASI overhead"},
   "max_cores": 1},
  {"operator": "fd_write of 512 MiB from linear memory to DST",
   "component": "WASI fd_write",
   "frozen": true,
   "why_every_version_executes_it": "DST must end up holding 512 MiB of data, and fd_write is the only path out of linear memory; a hard link is not a copy.",
   "least_work": {"amount": 536870912, "unit": "bytes", "per_unit_cost_us": 0.000125, "total_ms": 67.11,
                  "calling_context": "Large buffers (1 MiB or more), at the native write() rate of 8 GB/s into a new file with zero WASI overhead"},
   "max_cores": 1}
 ],
 "floor_ms": 67.11,
 "L_delta": 2.636,
 "rationale": "GNU uses one FICLONE ioctl, and wasip1 has no equivalent. Every admissible Y must fd_read and fd_write all 512 MiB. At 8 GB/s each is 67.1 ms on one core (wasip1 is single-threaded). L = max(134.2/4, 67.1) = 67.1 ms, and ln(67.1/4.81) = 2.64 > 0.236. Mutable fixes such as larger buffers cut the 131k syscalls but cannot go below this floor."}
